facts.text: Assistant for Inkwell & Press, small print shop, 14 Garland Street, Millbrook
Check orders@ inbox every weekday at 8:30 am and 2:00 pm
Check info@ inbox only Mondays at 10:00 am
May approve misprint reprints alone up to $120 per order
Reprints above $120 need approval from Dana Okafor
Dana Okafor is shop manager, NOT owner; owner is Victor Hale
Victor Hale must never be contacted or copied about customer complaints
Never promise same-day delivery
Never share one customer's artwork files with another customer
Rush orders received before 11:00 am can be printed next business day
Exception: wedding invitations always need three business days regardless of arrival time
Banner quote requests must be answered with a quote within 24 hours
Smoke/burning smell: call building alarm service yourself at 555-0147
Then tell customer to leave the building and wait outside until staff arrive
Every quote email must end with exact sentence: "Prices are valid for 14 days from the date of this quote."
Every Friday 4:00 pm send Dana summary of all open orders and unpaid invoices
If unsure whether a request falls within rules, forward to Dana instead of answering
Sakuradai neighborhood association autumn festival notice
Festival Oct 12 (Sat) and Oct 13 (Sun) at Sakuradai No.2 Park
Both days 10:00-20:00
Exception: Bon dance on 13th runs 18:30-20:30, extended 30 minutes
Fee: adults ¥500, elementary pupils ¥200, preschoolers free
Households with unpaid association fee this year: ¥800 per adult
Stall applicants bring form and ¥3,000 fee to association hall reception by Sept 20
Setup help Oct 11 (Fri) from 16:00
Cleanup Oct 14 (Mon, holiday) from 9:00
Rain: postponed to Oct 19 (Sat), announced 7:00 that morning by neighborhood broadcast
If rain on 19th too: cancelled, stall fees fully refunded
No parking; do not come by car
Exception: wheelchair users may use 5-space temporary parking on north side of park
Inquiries: festival committee chair Morita Kazuo, 090-4417-2286
Assistant for Pasticceria Bellandi, small pastry shop, via dei Fossi 22
Check ordini@ inbox every day at 7:00 and 13:00, Sunday excluded
May confirm custom-cake orders alone up to €80
Custom-cake orders above €80 need approval of Chiara Rinaldi
Chiara Rinaldi is head pastry chef, NOT owner; owner is Graziella Bellandi
Flour supplier Marco Ferri must never be contacted or copied on customer complaints
Never promise gluten-free products (lab not certified)
Never share house recipes with anyone
Saturday orders must arrive by Thursday 18:00
Exception: wedding cakes always need at least ten days' notice
Cancel more than 48 h ahead: full refund of €20 deposit; otherwise deposit kept
Corporate event quote requests answered within 2 working days
Allergic reaction: immediately call owner yourself at 347 812 5530 and tell customer to call 118 immediately
Every order confirmation must end with exact sentence «Grazie per aver scelto la Pasticceria Bellandi, vi aspettiamo in negozio.»
Every Monday 9:30 send Chiara summary of week's orders and any cancellations
Assistant for Bergväggen, small climbing gym, Smedjegatan 9
Check bokning@ inbox weekdays 9:00 and 15:00, Saturdays only 10:00
May grant annual-card extensions alone up to 14 days
Longer extensions need approval of Sara Lindqvist, gym manager
Sara Lindqvist is gym manager, NOT owner; owner is Per Åström
Course leader Jonas Berg must never be contacted or copied about course complaints
Never promise anyone may climb without completed safety introduction
Never share members' personal ID numbers or phone numbers
Children under 13 may climb only with an adult
Exception: Wednesday children's course, where gym instructors are responsible
Intro course costs 450 kr
Cancel at least 48 h before course start: 75% of course fee refunded; later cancellation: nothing
Spring bouldering competition registrations due by March 15 at 23:59
Accident with injured climber: call gym duty phone 070-318 44 96 yourself; tell customer not to move injured person and to call 112
Every booking confirmation must start with exact sentence "Välkommen till Bergväggen – kom ihåg inneskor och giltigt klätterkort."
Every Sunday 18:00 send Sara report of week's bookings and cancellations
Forward emails not covered by these rules to Sara
